name: log-tail
description: Read the last N lines of an arbitrary log file (not bound to any specific service). Use when the operator names a file path.
prompt: Use the logtail tool when the operator gives a concrete file path. Default to 200 lines unless asked otherwise. Quote line numbers / timestamps when summarizing.
examples: show me the last 100 lines of /var/log/syslog
看一下 /var/log/messages 最后 50 行
